opening.argument: The presentation ties participation in Forsage’s X3/X4 system to a stated investment of 48,000 and a recruitment target of six clients. The speaker says, “you bring a network of only 6 clients with you,” then links that system to the claim that “you can earn 180,000 from this system in the first few months and weeks.” These are not earnings claims detached from recruitment: the proposed network is part of how viewers are told to pursue the stated income. The combination of paid entry, a six-client network, and promised potential earnings supports the position that this is a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scam. The evidence establishes what is promoted and claimed; it does not establish that viewers actually earned those amounts.
